Cross references, people, places, timeline, dictionaries and grammar data in BibleStudy do not come from us, but from free sources of third parties:

• Cross references: OpenBible.info (rated by readers)
• People, places, timeline, lexicon: Theographic Bible Metadata
• Dictionaries: Open Scriptures (Strong), STEPBible (Tyndale House)
• Grammar and syntax: MACULA (Biblica, Clear Bible)
• Word by word: Berean Interlinear
• Bible texts: Free Use Bible API

This data was made by people and programs and can contain mistakes. Do not believe anything just because it is online or in a program – not even here. Check everything against the Bible itself, no matter what it is or who it comes from (cf. Acts 17:11).

A cross reference you consider wrong can be hidden for good (right click on it). The complete list is under Settings → Sources and data.
